shortDescription: Run `set system` commands on VyOS devices

options.name: domain_name
options.description: The new domain name to apply to the device.

options.name: domain_search
options.description: A list of domain names to search. Mutually exclusive with I(name_server)

options.name: host_name
options.description: Configure the device hostname parameter. This option takes an ASCII string value.

options.name: name_server
options.description: A list of name servers to use with the device. Mutually exclusive with I(domain_search)

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to apply (C(present)) or remove (C(absent)) the settings.
